resources.string: All native effects and saved profiles. Requires user-authorized Shizuku in ADB mode. Selected media audio is routed to ViPER; routing is released if replacement playback fails. Disabling returns to the selected legacy backend. Changing this stops processing.
Direct session compatibility (EQ and gain only)

Uses Android DynamicsProcessing on original playback without capture or muting. Only graphic EQ and post gain apply, with automatic EQ headroom and a fixed limiter; other ViPER effects do not apply. Changing this stops processing; switch power on again. Disable for the full ViPER capture engine.
